title: Signal: Vite development server serving the application
scope: One response body that references the Vite development client script.
limitations: One response body. The marker proves the dev client script is referenced; it does not enumerate which source modules are readable, and a production build that copies the marker would be a false positive.

observation.body: Run npm run dev, then open the URL printed by @vite/client.

fpNotes: A documentation page showing a Vite snippet is reported; confirm the path is not served rather than assuming the page is harmless.
